text1: Originally designed by frontier asteroid belt miners needing a broad, stable platform capable of maneuvering through dense tumbling debris fields, the Carcinus was aggressively refitted into a heavy skirmish cruiser. Featuring an extraordinarily wide, multi-segmented carapace and heavy forward pincer sponsons, its propulsion grid sacrifices conventional forward burn speed to achieve violent lateral vectoring. In fleet action, a skilled captain skitters along the edges of the battle line, keeping broadside weapons and heavy claw-mounts trained on the enemy while evading return fire with rapid sideways dashes.

Overclocks the transverse vector thrusters and inertial compensators, delivering an intense burst of lateral acceleration and turning speed to rapidly reposition around enemy broadsides or execute evasive maneuvers.
